Show the CLI's current display language

Usage:
  brickkit lang [flags]
  brickkit lang [command]

Available Commands:
  set         Set the CLI's display language

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for lang

Global Flags:
      --log-level string   Level of the JSON logs on stderr (debug | info | warn | error | off) (default "off")

Use "brickkit lang [command] --help" for more information about a command.
